Restart Runly to apply it?
bulk.offer:
{count} extensions are awaiting Windows approval.

A PowerShell command that binds all of them to Runly at once can be copied to the clipboard. It downloads the PS-SFTA script from a pinned revision, verifies it with SHA256 and assigns each extension in turn.

Yes: copy the command
No: open Windows settings
bulk.copied:
The command is on the clipboard.

Open PowerShell from the Start menu (no admin needed), paste with Ctrl+V and press Enter. Runly refreshes the status when you come back.

from the internet still show a warning. Continue?

menu.title: Runly context menu preview
menu.intro: Below is how the right-click menu will look for the chosen file type. Checked entries are hidden; uncheck to bring them back. Uninstalling Runly restores them all.
menu.empty: Nothing else to hide was found on Runly's file types.
menu.noTypes: No file type runs with Runly yet; bind one from the main window first.
menu.elsewhere: Entries not listed here (WinRAR, 7-Zip, Defender and the like) are classic shell extensions; turn them off in their own program's settings or uninstall the program.
menu.restartPrompt:
Some menu handlers only disappear or come back once Explorer restarts. Open folder windows will close.

Restart Explorer now?

bind.needsInstall:
{extension} has not been registered with Windows yet, so it does not appear on the Windows default apps page.

Choosing an application only writes Runly's own setting; Windows needs the installation step to learn about the extension.

Install it now and open Windows settings?
bind.notRegistered:
{extension} could not be registered with Windows even after installing.

The usual cause is that the row's application cannot be found, or the row is not enabled. Enable the extension and choose the application again.
